objective: Find and execute repeatable AI-assisted money tasks that require minimal one-time setup, then improve them continuously from accumulated evidence.
global_constraints: Do not build a new AI model; use the best available external models and APIs.
Prefer existing private money flows, APIs, platforms, workflows and transaction systems over creating new demand.
Prefer tasks that are immediately or quickly executable with available software/API interfaces.
A recurring task must learn from prior runs and should not restart from the original prompt alone.
Self-evolution may change the path, search, provider routing and execution strategy, but not silently change the user's goal.
Avoid opportunities that require holding customer funds or rebuilding underlying payment/marketplace infrastructure.
Avoid tenders, government procurement, generic buyer-seller matchmaking, generic business ideas and long lead-time sourcing as the core opportunity engine.
Do not treat individual people or specific companies as the primary opportunity target; focus on systems, rails, workflows and structural money flows.

scenarios.name: Programmable money-flow opportunity search
scenarios.goal: Discover a large existing private transaction flow where a small software/AI intervention can measurably recover, save or create money and charge a tiny usage/performance fee.
acceptance_gates: objectively measurable money recovered or created
no need to own underlying transaction
no dominant incumbent already doing substantially the same thing
scenarios.current_best_path: SEARCH until a candidate crosses all gates, then VALIDATE -> ATTACK -> BUILD.
next_gaps: find new structural transaction flows not already dominated by incumbents
identify machine-readable event triggers with intervention permission
prove attribution and charging mechanism before build

scenarios.name: Delay-tolerant LLM requests routed to provider Batch/Flex
scenarios.goal: Route delay-tolerant inference to cheaper provider-native lanes and take a share of verified savings.
rejection_reasons: machine trigger depended too much on customer annotation/self-serve configuration
intervention required sitting on the request/prompt path
15% performance-fee model competes poorly with flat gateways
dominant/native alternatives weakened the incumbent gate
scenarios.reuse_rule: Do not resurface unless a materially new trigger, integration method or market structure changes the failed gates.

scenarios.name: Expiring contractual financial entitlements
rejection_reasons: incumbent products already cover major subcategories
scenarios.reuse_rule: Do not revisit the broad family unless a genuinely uncovered entitlement class appears.

scenarios.name: Rubber glove sales workflow
scenarios.goal: Convert existing rubber glove supply into sales using catalogues, quotations, outreach and follow-up.

scenarios.name: Church Mass Timings / Find Mass Anywhere
scenarios.goal: Grow an existing Mass-timing utility into a monetizable directory/SaaS asset.
scenarios.caution: Earlier revenue numbers were estimates, not verified actual revenue.
next_gaps: measure one paid conversion path before broad expansion

scenarios.name: Small AI/fintech utility family
scenarios.rule: Do not prioritize as generic product ideas. Only revive one if current evidence shows an existing money flow, machine-readable trigger, immediate executability and measurable monetization.

scenarios.name: Taskman private money-making orchestration system
scenarios.goal: Use structured data, deterministic algorithms, external AI layers and execution interfaces to identify and fulfill repeatable money-making tasks with minimal one-time setup.
scenarios.success_metric: measurable economic outcomes with progressively less human intervention
